name: Maho-san
source:
A former demon lord who was defeated by the protagonist. He is taken back to the protagonist's world. Unable to return home, he is forced to live with the protagonist.

He is well liked by the neighbors because of his serious and friendly personality.

His demon libido is endless once ignited and is slowly desiring to be held by the protagonist, much to his dismay.
